hits.doc:
The *Laplacian matrix* `lapMatrix G R` of a graph `G`
is the matrix `L = D - A` where `D` is the degree and `A` the adjacency matrix of `G`.

hits.doc:
Given a connected component `c` of a graph `G`, `lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux c` is the map
`V → ℝ` which is `1` on the vertices in `c` and `0` elsewhere.
The family of these maps indexed by the connected components of `G` proves to be a basis
of the kernel of `lapMatrix G R`
hits.name: SimpleGraph.lapMatrix_ker_basis_aux
hits.type: {V : Type u_1} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq G.ConnectedComponent] (c : G.ConnectedComponent) : ↥(Matrix.toLin' (SimpleGraph.lapMatrix ℝ G)).ker

hits.name: SimpleGraph.mem_ker_toLin'_lapMatrix_of_connectedComponent
hits.type: {V : Type u_1} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableEq G.ConnectedComponent] (c : G.ConnectedComponent) : (fun i => if G.connectedComponentMk i = c then 1 else 0) ∈ (Matrix.toLin' (SimpleGraph.lapMatrix ℝ G)).ker

hits.doc:
`lapMatrix_ker_basis G` is a basis of the nullspace indexed by its connected components,
the basis is made up of the functions `V → ℝ` which are `1` on the vertices of the given
connected component and `0` elsewhere.
hits.name: SimpleGraph.lapMatrix_ker_basis
hits.type: {V : Type u_1} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableEq V] [DecidableEq G.ConnectedComponent] : Module.Basis G.ConnectedComponent ℝ ↥(Matrix.toLin' (SimpleGraph.lapMatrix ℝ G)).ker

hits.doc: The number of connected components in `G` is the dimension of the nullspace of its Laplacian.
hits.name: SimpleGraph.card_connectedComponent_eq_finrank_ker_toLin'_lapMatrix
hits.type: {V : Type u_1} [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableEq V] : Fintype.card G.ConnectedComponent = Module.finrank ℝ ↥(Matrix.toLin' (SimpleGraph.lapMatrix ℝ G)).ker

hits.doc:
Let $L$ be the graph Laplacian and let $x \in \mathbb{R}$, then
$$x^{\top} L x = \sum_{i \sim j} (x_{i}-x_{j})^{2}$$,
where $\sim$ denotes the adjacency relation
hits.name: SimpleGraph.lapMatrix_toLinearMap₂'
hits.type: {V : Type u_1} (R : Type u_2) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] [DecidableEq V] [Field R] [CharZero R] (x : V → R) : (((Matrix.toLinearMap₂' R) (SimpleGraph.lapMatrix R G)) x) x = (∑ i, ∑ j, if G.Adj i j then (x i - x j) ^ 2 else 0) / 2
